title: Media import base64-encodes the whole file into a JSON body, so anything over ~75 MiB is refused and over ~384 MiB dies silently
description: uploadMediaFile posts the file as a base64 data URL, which caps import at ~75 MiB (bodyParser 100mb) and at ~384 MiB stops producing a string at all (V8 max string length). Send the on-disk path via webUtils.getPathForFile and let the server copy the file instead. Detail: brief.md.
